evals.prompt: My app throws 'missing async stack' when I change a UI control. We use strict setup. Please debug it.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies strict-context callback boundaries as the likely failing layer, checks whether observability/setup is in place first (including dev-time connectLogger in the earliest setup import), inspects the handwritten callback for missing wrap(), and proves the fix with the narrowest repro or test command instead of removing clearStack.

assertions.name: connect_logger_preflight
assertions.text: The response verifies or asks to verify whether connectLogger is wired in the earliest development setup import before broad debugging changes.

assertions.name: wrap_boundary_focus
assertions.text: The response treats the likely root cause as a host callback crossing back into Reatom without wrap(), not as a reason to remove strict setup.

assertions.name: narrow_proof_required
assertions.text: The response requires a narrow proof command or concrete repro result before claiming the debug fix is complete.

evals.prompt: Our routed Reatom page keeps logging AbortError and redirecting back and forth. Can you debug it?
evals.expected_output: The agent keeps logger visibility on, treats the abort spam as route-ownership evidence, inspects guards/loaders/redirect ownership before muting logs, and narrows the issue to the smallest route boundary with proof.

assertions.name: logger_not_removed_first
assertions.text: The response does not recommend silencing connectLogger or removing debug visibility as the first step.

assertions.name: route_ownership_focus
assertions.text: The response focuses on route ownership, redirect idempotence, or loader matching/invalidation before generic cleanup.

evals.prompt: After adding clearStack to tests, several Reatom tests fail with missing async stack. Debug the test setup.
evals.expected_output: The agent matches the suite's strict context style, checks for context.start() or a reusable strict test helper, and repairs the test harness or host callback boundary instead of backing out strict setup blindly.

assertions.name: strict_test_harness_checked
assertions.text: The response checks whether strict tests run inside context.start(...) or a reusable test helper.

assertions.name: no_blind_clearstack_removal
assertions.text: The response does not treat removing clearStack as the default fix.
